Archive the latest run of a model

Source: R/archive.R
archive_run.Rd

Keeps an exact copy of each model's latest run so it can be checked and brought back later, while the live project folder stays usable: nothing in it is changed, moved or locked.

Usage

archive_run(
  path,
  store = default_store(),
  archive = getOption("mlxtrx.archive", store)
)

Arguments

path

Character vector. Project files, folders, or recorded input or output files, as in run_status().

store

Character scalar. The run store directory (see default_store()). Defaults to default_store().

archive

Character scalar. The folder that holds the objects folder. Defaults to the mlxtrx.archive option, or else the store folder itself (objects in <store>/objects).

Value

Invisibly, a data frame with one row per model and columns project_file, run_id, n_files (files in the manifest), n_new (objects written by this call; files already in the archive are not counted) and bytes_new (their total size in bytes).

Details

What is archived, for the latest run of each model path covers (the same models as run_status()): the project file, every recorded input (model, data, other referenced files and the config file; Monolix library models lib: are not files and are skipped), every recorded output, and the copy of the tool's config.ini kept with the run.

Where: each file is stored once under its SHA-256 as <archive>/objects/<first 2 hex>/<remaining 62 hex>, so a file shared by several runs (e.g. a data set) is stored only once. Each copy is checked against the recorded hash before it is put in place, and an object that already exists is reused, never rewritten. The run's folder in the store gets a manifest archive.json listing each archived file (its path as recorded, io type, input role, SHA-256 and size), when and by whom it was archived, and the archive location.

Every model must be "clean" or "clean_late" in run_status(), so the files on disk are those the run recorded; otherwise nothing is written and the error lists each model with its condition. A model whose latest run is already archived gets a message and nothing is written for it.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
archive_run("base/run3.mlxtran")
run_status("base")$archived
} # }
